description: Watch one Derive yield note to expiry: a heads-up the day before, the outcome once it settles, and, only if the owner asked, buying the asset an assigned put agreed to.

INSTRUMENT.description: Derive's own name for the option sold, exactly as it was filled: ETH-20261030-2450-P. The expiry and strike are read back out of this, so it must match the fill.

PRODUCT.description: Which note this is. A put ends in the owner buying the asset; a call ends in them selling it.

UNDERLYING.description: The asset ticker: ETH, BTC. Used for the settlement read and, if DELIVER_ASSET is on, the spot buy.

TOKEN_ID.description: The underlying pinned to one token when the duty is filed, from the /token-search row for UNDERLYING: native:<chainId> for the chain's coin (ETH on Base is native:8453), <address>:<chainId> for a token such as cbBTC. The heads-up prices exactly this pin with /token-stats and the delivery buy trades it on its chain.

STRIKE.description: The price the owner agreed to buy at (put) or sell at (call).

SIZE.description: Contracts sold, in units of the underlying.

PREMIUM_USD.description: What the owner kept at open, net of Derive's fee: the filled premium minus the fee, exactly as the open reported it. Quoted back at expiry, so never the gross.

COLLATERAL_USD.description: USDC locked behind a put, as the open reported it. 0 for a covered call, which is collateralised by the asset itself.

DELIVER_ASSET.description: Only for a put that settles in the money. Derive settles in cash, so the owner holds the loss in cash and no asset. With this on, the duty spends SIZE x the settlement price of wallet USDC buying the TOKEN_ID token on its chain. Off by default: it spends money, so the owner has to have asked.

HEADS_UP_HOURS.description: How long before expiry to send the heads-up. Sent once.
